name: uno-ultra-game
description: UNO ULTRA — Competitive card game monorepo (Authoritative WebSocket/TCP + Optional WebRTC/UDP Telemetry & Voice)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n shared,srv-tsc,server,client -c yellow,blue,cyan,magenta "npx tsc -p shared/tsconfig.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "npx tsc -p server/tsconfig.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "node --env-file-if-exists=.env --watch --watch-path=server/dist --watch-path=shared/dist server/dist/index.js" "npm run dev --workspace=client"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=shared && npm run build --workspace=server && npm run build --workspace=client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=shared && tsc -p shared/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p server/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p client/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=shared && npm run test --workspace=server && npm run test --workspace=client
scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run test
